tools.name: list_pricing
tools.description: List credit prices for every generation tool and launch-kit tier. 1 credit = $0.01. To buy credits with USDC on Base, use get_payment_info and claim_payment.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Return the caller's remaining credits, daily spend, and spend cap.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Poll a background generation job by id. Returns status, progress, and asset links when done. Scoped to the calling API key.

tools.name: get_payment_info
tools.description: Return the USDC-on-Base receiving address, network, token, credit packs, and step-by-step instructions so an agent can top up its own credits without a human. Send native USDC on Base mainnet, wait for confirmations, then call claim_payment with the tx hash. x402 is a future option and is not implem

tools.name: claim_payment
tools.description: Credit this API key after a USDC transfer on Base mainnet. Pass the transaction hash. Verifies the on-chain Transfer to the configured payment address, required confirmations, and amount, then credits the ledger once (tx hash + log index is unique). tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate one still: a logo, wide 3:1 banner (1536x512 / 1500x500 class), or meme. Runs synchronously.

tools.name: generate_logo_kit
tools.description: Generate four original logo options (wordmark, emblem, lettermark, mascot). Returns a job_id immediately; poll get_job for assets.

tools.name: generate_banner
tools.description: Generate two wide X banner variants at 1536x512 (3:1 / 1500x500 class). Returns a job_id immediately; poll get_job for assets.

tools.name: generate_sticker_pack
tools.description: Generate six consistent-character Telegram stickers, 512x512 PNG with a real alpha channel (solid plate + BiRefNet cutout). Returns a job_id immediately; poll get_job for assets.

tools.name: generate_teaser_video
tools.description: Generate an original ~10 second launch teaser with no baked-in text. Optional project_name is overlaid in post when ffmpeg is available. Use tier=budget for MiniMax Turbo. Returns a job_id immediately; poll get_job. Music is a separate tool or mixed in generate_launch_kit.

tools.name: generate_music_bed
tools.description: Generate an instrumental music bed for a launch video or stream. Returns a job_id immediately; poll get_job.

tools.name: generate_launch_kit
tools.description: One prompt produces the full kit: logo x4, wide banner x2, alpha stickers x6, teaser, and music. Returns a job_id immediately so the client connection does not have to stay open. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "generate_launch_kit" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
